faqs.question: How do websites work?
faqs.answer: Websites work through a client-server model. This topic is covered in **Video 1: Installing VS Code & How Websites Work** starting at **0:00**. The video explains how browsers request web pages from servers, how HTML structures content, and the basic architecture of the web.
faqs.videoTitle: Installing VS Code & How Websites Work

faqs.question: Where is CSS taught?
faqs.answer: CSS is introduced in **Video 14: Introduction to CSS** at **0:00**. The course then covers CSS in depth with **Video 15: Inline, Internal & External CSS** at **0:00**, and **Video 17: CSS Selectors MasterClass** at **0:00**. You'll learn about styling, selectors, and the box model.
faqs.videoTitle: Introduction to CSS, CSS Types, CSS Selectors

faqs.question: What are HTML entities?
faqs.answer: HTML entities are covered in **Video 13: Entities, Code tag and more on HTML** starting at **0:00**. This video explains how to use special characters like <, >, and & in your HTML code without breaking the structure.
faqs.videoTitle: Entities, Code tag and more on HTML

faqs.question: How to create forms in HTML?
faqs.answer: HTML forms are taught in **Video 7: Forms and input tags in HTML** at **0:00**. You'll learn about form elements, input types, buttons, and how to collect user data.
faqs.videoTitle: Forms and input tags in HTML

faqs.question: What is the HTML box model?
faqs.answer: The CSS Box Model is explained in **Video 18: CSS Box Model - Margin, Padding & Borders** at **0:00**. This video covers how elements are sized and spaced using margin, padding, and borders.
faqs.videoTitle: CSS Box Model - Margin, Padding & Borders

faqs.question: How to add images in HTML?
faqs.answer: Adding images is covered in **Video 5: Image, Lists, and Tables in HTML** at **0:00**. You'll learn how to use the <img> tag with proper attributes like src and alt.
faqs.videoTitle: Image, Lists, and Tables in HTML

faqs.question: What are semantic tags?
faqs.answer: Semantic HTML tags are explained in **Video 11: Semantic Tags in HTML** at **0:00**. This covers tags like <header>, <nav>, <article>, <section>, and <footer> that give meaning to your HTML structure.

faqs.question: How to use CSS selectors?
faqs.answer: CSS selectors are covered comprehensively in **Video 17: CSS Selectors MasterClass** at **0:00**. This video teaches you how to target specific HTML elements using class selectors, ID selectors, attribute selectors, and more.

faqs.question: What is SEO in HTML?
faqs.answer: SEO and Core Web Vitals are covered in **Video 6: SEO and Core Web Vitals in HTML** at **0:00**. You'll learn about meta tags, proper HTML structure for search engines, and performance optimization.
faqs.videoTitle: SEO and Core Web Vitals in HTML

faqs.question: What are inline and block elements?
faqs.answer: Inline and block elements are explained in **Video 8: Inline & Block Elements in HTML** at **0:00**. This video covers the difference between elements that flow inline with text versus elements that create new blocks.

faqs.question: How to create your first HTML website?
faqs.answer: Creating your first HTML website is covered in **Video 2: Your First HTML Website** at **0:00**. This video walks you through creating a complete HTML page from scratch.

faqs.question: What is the basic structure of HTML?
faqs.answer: The basic HTML structure is taught in **Video 3: Basic Structure of an HTML Website** at **0:00**. You'll learn about <html>, <head>, <body>, and other essential tags.
faqs.videoTitle: Basic Structure of an HTML Website

faqs.question: How to use headings and paragraphs?
faqs.answer: Headings, paragraphs, and links are covered in **Video 4: Heading, Paragraphs and Links** at **0:00**. This video explains how to structure content with h1-h6 tags, p tags, and create hyperlinks.

faqs.question: What are IDs and classes in HTML?
faqs.answer: IDs and Classes are explained in **Video 9: Id & Classes in HTML** at **0:00**. You'll learn how to use these attributes to identify and style specific elements.

faqs.question: How to add video and audio?
faqs.answer: Adding video and audio is taught in **Video 10: Video, Audio & Media in HTML** at **0:00**. This covers the <video> and <audio> tags with all their attributes.
